window_policy.24h: Fresh releases/updates/news first when production value is comparable.
window_policy.7d: Backfill unpublished production workflows, tests, add-ons, DCC/engine techniques and AI-assisted findings.
window_policy.30d: Backfill production cases, workflow breakdowns, technical-art examples and credible community/GitHub discoveries.
window_policy.6m: Backfill high-value research, references, conference material and missed production intelligence.
window_policy.evergreen: Final tier: verifiable still-current official references, workflows or cases with concrete production value.

collection.fill_target_policy: Aim for 30 valid unpublished items after registry dedupe and Quality Gate. 20 is the release floor, not a discovery stop. Category counts are diversity diagnostics, never quotas. Exhaust configured backfill tiers before accepting shortage; 20-29 may publish after reasonable exhaustion; never pad.

A.label: major-intelligence
A.guidance: Major models/versions, meaningful features/workflows, pricing/licensing/availability or major engine/DCC/AI production changes.

B.label: production-intelligence
B.guidance: Practical asset, modeling, retopo, UV, texture/material/shader, rig/animation, mocap/retarget, engine, AI 3D/motion, pipeline and tooling lessons.

C.label: case-tip-community
C.guidance: Verifiable cases, breakdowns, add-ons, GitHub tools, demos, research prototypes and community workflows with concrete takeaways.

exclude: pure hype with no evidence or operational takeaway
collection.completeness_trigger_policy: Release-ready at 20-30 valid unpublished items after dedupe, Quality Gate and reasonable fill-ladder exhaustion. Target/max 30; category shortages never block or justify padding.
collection.ranking_guidance: Production value first; then user-interest fit, practical testability, source reliability, novelty/substantive delta and freshness. Freshness must not outrank materially more useful production intelligence. Preferences are signals, not quotas.

production_intelligence_profile.purpose: Surface intelligence most likely to improve game-art production quality, efficiency, pipeline decisions, testing priorities or workflows over the next 6-24 months.
production_intelligence_profile.category_quota_policy: Interest scores and preferences guide discovery/ranking only; never create per-category quotas or filler.

ranking.freshness_rule: Prefer newer when value is comparable; allow 1-6 month or evergreen material to outrank fresh low-value news.
ranking.source_rule: Official, community, video, case, GitHub and research sources are all admissible when verifiable; source type alone does not determine rank.
ranking.selection_rule: Mixed slate: consequential updates first, then strongest tests, workflows, breakdowns, tools and cases.

global_downrank: showcase with little production detail unless category permits reference value
old content used mainly to fill quantity
global_hard_exclude: unrelated to game-art and not transferable

ai-generation.ai_motion_video_rule: Video-only character motion may qualify without skeletal export when it has concrete animation reference/previs/production value.
ai-generation.backfill: actively allow 1-6m/evergreen unpublished production tests and workflows

3d-production.prop_policy: Hard-surface, weapons, mechanical assets, vehicles and game props are high priority.
3d-production.style_policy: Stylized, NPR, semi-realistic and realistic/AAA all score 5; style is not a gate.
3d-production.tutorial_policy: Good tutorials qualify; boost new methods and measurable quality/efficiency gains.
hard_exclude: beginner content with little transferable value
3d-production.backfill: older strong cases qualify but rank below equally valuable recent material

3d-animation.breakdown_policy: high priority even when not news
3d-animation.showcase_policy: pure showcase only when quality/reference value is exceptional

hard_exclude: pure programming/engineering with no material art-production relevance

emerging-case.research_policy: Novel research can enter discovery; selection favors production potential and near-usability.
emerging-case.open_source_policy: research code/GitHub qualifies only with clear production potential
emerging-case.world_model: include with credible game/3D production potential
emerging-case.conference_policy: allow GDC/SIGGRAPH/Unreal Fest/GTC/Unity backfill; newer wins when value is equal
hard_exclude: pure mathematical derivation without production consequence

blender-dcc.blender_tip_policy: useful small tips qualify when they save time, improve quality or simplify workflow
blender-dcc.maya_policy: include when method has cross-DCC transferable value
blender-dcc.houdini_policy: all major Houdini production areas discoverable; rank by value
blender-dcc.new_tool_policy: include niche DCC tools only with clear production value
hard_exclude: DCC use unrelated to game art and not transferable

full_analysis.quality_rule: Each block must add one distinct, source-supported production insight; do not pad or restate summary/quick_impact.
writing_guidance: Use concise Traditional Chinese headings; keep product/DCC/engine abbreviations when useful.
Choose 3-5 content-specific analysis angles rather than fixed template headings.
State concrete capability/delta, workflow value, then adoption/test/risk judgment.
Keep V3 depth without filler or repeated context.
For AI motion, when supported, cover input/output rig compatibility, root/fingers/face/multi-person, cleanup/foot lock, retarget, local/cloud, speed, licensing and engine integration.
Use 2026-09-01 as readability reference; do not rewrite historical pages.
